text.card: A red giant 5,440 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.80 solar masses and 10.2 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,922 K at its surface.
